description: มุน 2026-07-28: with Zone 5 (SinseSection) + Zone 6 (PajeuSection) now the last two sections, the page-END is the risk. บอง/ฟีม closed the question: the content column already has pb-36 (144px) which clears the fixed bottom-nav (~94px @393); Zone 5/6 live INSIDE that column (flow), and there is NO hardcoded 140px gap (grep-verified) — the Figma ~140px gap IS the existing nav allowance, not a spacer to re-add. run-page-end.ts owns the page-level pixels: (1) nav-clearance — scrolled to the BOTTOM, the last content (เรียนปาจื่อ) sits ABOVE the fixed nav at 393/360/320 (measured +74px gap each) — a dropped/shrunk pb-36 hides content behind the nav, invisible to tsc/console, only the rendered geometry catches it; (2) zone-continuity — all six zones render in order (greeting -> manifest -> ดวงสมพงค์ -> โหมดเซียน -> ดูดวงส่วนตัว -> เรียนปาจื่อ), a broken import/mis-order regresses the page silently; (3) no-overflow-x across the full page (incl. the full-bleed Zone 5 banner + overflowing mascot) @393/360/320. Teeth: mut-shrink-pad (drop the pb-36 clearance -> last content slides under the nav) CAUGHT. Runs against the deterministic home-preview (no BE); the BE-up console-clean real-/v2 pass is deferred (the testenv BE outbound SMS/LINE pipe is currently live, so booting BE is a runtime/infra seam routed to goo/ฟีม, not done unilaterally). gate_layer=visual/layout.
